deferredForEditableCoding.allRequiredTextConnectorsAndPlacementIns: Show independently verified recipient and purpose → payment method → scan or copy and compare destination → check amount, unit, fee or expiry, and final summary → small test when unfamiliar → approve only if all checks match → check the result. Branch to stop and verify if anything differs.
